name: sm232ae_tq10_noload
status: fitted to one bench capture, not independently validated
description: Parker/Compumotor SM232AE motor + TQ10 drive, free shaft, no load, driven by the analog-servo F103 firmware (RC-filtered PWM torque command). Single rigid body; drive path as an analog chain. See docs/sm232ae_tq10_noload.md.

source.method: closed loop: real analog-servo Control.c/Signal.c/MotionQueue.c driving this plant through the same sequence; differential evolution + Nelder-Mead on step traces, ramp phase-mean torque/error, post-step creep, rest chatter

units.position: encoder counts, 4096 per rev (quadrature edges); read with SimmyChainFeedbackPositionCounts (integer rounding = encoder quantization)
units.force: analog-servo firmware torque units, axis frame, full scale +-32767 (not N*m, not amps)
units.analogChain: every stage parameter is per analog-chain CALL; this preset assumes analogStepsPerTick calls per tick, each followed by SimmyChainStepDt(..., 1.0/analogStepsPerTick)
